abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.
